root.ecoText: Hive is not a shiny new toy. We've been around for a while, and have grown a thriving ecosystem of hundreds of dapps, communities & projects. We are home to some of the most used Web3 dapps in the world, such as Splinterlands, PeakD, and Ecency.
root.walletsText:
Wallets are incredibly important to securely store your cryptocurrencies and to interact with Web3 apps.
Hive has multiple community-owned and open-source wallets available for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android & Web.
root.dafText: The development of Hive and its ecosystem is made possible by the community. To incentivize crucial work, the same community can engage in stake-weighted voting to fund proposals via the Decentralised Hive Fund (DHF).

exchanges.title: Listed Exchanges
exchanges.subtitle: Trade HIVE on 40+ exchanges worldwide. Maximum liquidity, maximum accessibility.

root.hbdText: HBD is a USD-pegged algorithmic stablecoin backed by HIVE. We currently provide one of the highest interest rates in the crypto space for holding HBD in savings.
root.hbdAPR: The interest rate is variable and is voted by the Witnesses.
root.decText: Hive is one of the most decentralized blockchains. There is no single entity or organization that controlls the network. Everything is run by the community members.
root.usernameText: Wallet addresses in Hive are easy to remember. They look and act just like usernames in traditional applications. In other words, a username is a wallet address and a social media handle at the same time.

about.title: Built for Web
about.text: Hive is a feeless, community-owned blockchain and a public social and identity layer for the open web. Build on Hive's open-source full stack, or extend cross-chain and web apps with Hive accounts, posts and payments that confirm in less than 3 seconds.
about.featureFastText: Hive produces a block every 3 seconds. With one-block irreversibility, a transaction becomes final in under a second after being included in a block.
about.featureScalableText: Efficiency is key. Hive is optimized for sustainability and flexibility with layered solutions. Nodes can run on modest hardware, keeping the network accessible to all.
about.featurePowerfulText: Block producers elected by Hive's stakeholders run the network from around the world, with no downtime. No company, server or country can switch it off, and stakeholders can vote out any producer at any time.

eco.title: Apps Built on Hive
eco.text: The people who use the Hive blockchain are the ones expanding what it can do. Writers run social forums, gamers ship TCGs and RPGs, traders build markets and interfaces, and developers create wallets, analytics and explorers.
eco.text2: Connect your site or service to Hive and your apps and tools all share one open graph, so an account made for any one works across them all.
eco.searchPlaceholder: Search apps by name or what they do
eco.noResults: No app matches that search. Try another word or clear the filter.
eco.projectsText: Hive Projects is a self-submitted directory of apps, sites and tools built on Hive over the years. Some are no longer running, and newer apps may not be listed yet.
eco.buildText: Every site and service on this page reads the same open graph via Hive. <accounts>Accounts</accounts>, <posts>posts</posts>, <votes>votes</votes>, <json>custom json</json>, <transfers>transfers</transfers> and <other>more</other> confirm in a new block every 3 seconds with no transaction fees, and any app can stream them live or pull them with custom queries and APIs. Build something new on Hive's shared public data, and it's automatically connected to everything already in the ecosystem.

faq.q1: Do I need a new account for each Hive app?
faq.a1: No, your Hive account is a wallet address that works on every app connected to the Hive blockchain. Your data, content, relationships and assets belong to you, not to any platform.
faq.q2: How do I log in to a Hive app safely?
faq.a2: Use Hive Keychain, HiveAuth, or another signing service, which allow you to make transactions without handing your keys to an app. Never paste your owner key or master password into a website.
faq.q3: How do I get my Hive app listed here?
faq.a3: Add it to <projects>Hive Projects</projects>, then open an issue on the <repo>hive.io repository</repo>. Listed apps connect with a signing service and do not ask for wallet keys directly. A listing is not an endorsement.

hbd.title: Hive Backed Dollar
hbd.text: HBD is a native stablecoin on the Hive blockchain. HBD is built to hold $1USD value in the most decentralized ways. It benefits from the fee-less and fast transactions of the Hive blockchain.
hbd.howTitle: How does it maintain the $1USD peg?
hbd.howText: There are two decentralized conversion operations designed to achieve this goal. HIVE to HBD conversion and HBD to HIVE conversion. These two operations keep the price at $1USD with a tight margin.
hbd.hbdToHiveText: This operation converts set amounts of HBD to $1USD worth of HIVE with no extra fees. It takes 3.5 days for the conversion to finalize. The price in this conversion is the median price of the coming 3.5 days to prevent market manipulations.
hbd.hiveToHbdText: This operation is a collateral-based conversion. After initializing the conversion of the X amount of HIVE to HBD, the user gets Y amount of HBD immediately. The Y is equivalent of the value of X/2 of the HIVE. The cost for Y amount of HBD is calculated after 3.5 days and the remaining HIVE is returned to the user. The price is the median price of the 3.5 days. This conversion has a 5% fee which is burned in the process.
hbd.interestText: HBD you move into savings stays in your own Hive account, with no custodian, and earns interest. Withdrawals take 3 days. The rate is variable and <link>set by witnesses</link>, currently {aprPercent}% APR.
hbd.interestTextWitnesses: HBD you move into savings stays in your own Hive account, with no custodian, and earns interest. Withdrawals take 3 days. The rate is variable and <link>set by witnesses</link>.
hbd.moreInfoText: You can grab the latest figures at
hbd.risksText: HBD has two safety limits based on how much currently exists compared with the total combined value of HIVE and HBD. When existing HBD reaches {stopPercent}% of that value, new HBD stops being created for rewards and conversions. At a 30% debt ratio, the haircut rule activates automatically and HBD converts to less than $1 of HIVE, which caps the debt.

developers.title: Build on Hive
developers.intro: Hive is an open-source blockchain with no transaction fees, human-readable account names and one-block irreversibility. Developers choose Hive because it's fast with near-instant finality, carries custom text data at base layer, costs users nothing per transaction, and is quick to get started on: the first API call needs no node and no signup.
developers.buildTypes: Our builders create games, social apps, payment and financial services, timestamping and verification tools, and apps that read public account and post data. The Hive tech stack is more than just truly decentralized cryptocurrency: it balances flexibility and speed with immutability and censorship resistance. Click and explore a selection of <eco>live apps and services across the Hive ecosystem</eco> for inspiration.
developers.activitySource: Merged pull requests from the Hive repos <tracker>HiveDevsTracker</tracker> follows on GitHub and GitLab.
developers.bandText: <accounts>Accounts</accounts>, <posts>posts</posts>, <votes>votes</votes>, <json>json</json>, <transfers>transfers</transfers> and <other>more</other> confirm in the next block, with no transaction fees. Read from head block quickly enough for web2 response times and user experiences.
developers.toolsTitle: Hive APIs, libraries and node software

tools.hive: The node software that produces and validates blocks and serves the core APIs. Run one to follow the chain yourself.
tools.haf: A HAF server fills a PostgreSQL database from a hived node, so you write your API or app in SQL instead of parsing blocks.
tools.hivemind: Social API: posts, communities and follows.
tools.haf_block_explorer: The API behind Hive block explorers.
tools.wax: Hive API library for TypeScript and Python.
tools.workerbee: Streams blocks and reacts to chain events, built on wax.
tools.dhive: JavaScript library for Hive APIs, in Node.js and the browser.
tools.beekeeper: Wallet daemon that holds keys and signs over HTTP or WebSocket.
tools.keychain: Browser extension and mobile wallet most Hive apps use to sign transactions.
tools.hivesigner: OAuth2-style sign-in and signing for web apps, maintained by Ecency.
